name: AA Industrial Belting (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd
summary: AA Industrial Belting (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd research, develops, produces, and sells lightweight conveyor belts in China. The company offers lightweight conveyor, easy-clean, synchronous, felt, roller tension, elevator steel, and winding machine belts, as well as auxiliary materials. Its products are used in aluminum profile processing, textiles, printing and dyeing, food processing, logistics and transportation, agricultural products processing, entertainment and fitness, wood processing, electronics manufacturing, and printing and packaging. AA Industrial Belting (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Shanghai, China.
